title: Facebook slow to act on posts celebrating murder of Jews, anti-hate group says
summary: Exclusive: CST highlights volume of IS-supporting accounts and says social media firms ‘putting all of us in danger’ Facebook hosted terrorist propaganda that celebrated the murder of Jews and praised Islamic State, a leading anti-hate group has alleged. The posts included celebrations of the Bondi beach massacre that the Community Security Trust says Facebook has been too slow to take down. The posts were still on Facebook on 16 December, two days after the attack, and received shares and likes. Continue reading...

title: Foreign Office cautioned against UK military action to overthrow Robert Mugabe
summary: Archives reveal options considered by Tony Blair’s government for dealing with Zimbabwean dictator in 2004 The Foreign Office cautioned against UK military intervention to overthrow the former Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe in 2004, advising it was not a “serious option”, recently released documents show. Policy papers show Tony Blair’s government weighed up options on how best to handle the “depressingly healthy” 80-year-old dictator, who refused to step down while the country descended into violence and economic chaos. Continue reading...

title: With Artillery and Warships, China Practices Blockading Taiwan
summary: China flew bombers and fired long-range artillery during a second day of exercises designed to show its ability to claim the island-democracy by force.

title: Khaleda Zia, Bangladesh’s First Female Prime Minister, Dies
summary: In office for three terms, she traded the country’s leadership with Sheikh Hasina, the head of another political dynasty, over decades. She was believed to be 80.
